scenario.name: Subnet-scoped firewall rule blocks ERP for Singapore users
scenario.description: A quarantine rule on the data centre firewall denies HTTPS from the Singapore user VLAN to the ERP server only; management hosts, voice and internet access keep working.

incident.title: Singapore staff cannot open ERP; IT admins at the same site can
incident.description: Singapore desktop users get a timeout when opening ERP. The local IT administrator reaches ERP from the management jump host and users suspect the slow Singapore WAN.
symptoms: ERP connection timeout for desktop users
ERP works from the site jump host

ground_truth.root_cause: Rule FWR-DC1-0127 (QUARANTINE-SIN-USERS-ERP), committed on DC1-FW-01 at incident onset, denies TCP 443 from 10.20.10.0/24 to 10.100.100.40/32 ahead of the ERP allow rule FWR-DC1-0130.
